mapper.select: select ct.id as templateId, cn.id as calcNodeId, cn.node_id as sourceNodeId, cn.parent_id as parentCalcNodeId, cn.name as nodeName, coalesce(cn.node_category, ni.node_category) as nodeCategory from emission_calculation_node cn inner join emission_calculation_template ct on ct.id = cn.calculation_template_id left join emission_node_info ni on ni.node_id = cn.node_id where ct.status = 2 and ct.calculation_cycle_end_date >= #{rangeStart} and ct.calculation_cycle_start_date <= #{rangeEnd}

select ct.id as templateId, date_format(ct.calculation_cycle_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as cycleStart, date_format(ct.calculation_cycle_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as cycleEnd, date_format(ct.calculation_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as calculationEndTime, cn.id as calcNodeId, cn.node_id as sourceNodeId, cn.name as nodeName, coalesce(cn.node_category, ni.node_category) as nodeCategory, s.energy_category_l1 as energyCategoryL1, s.energy_category_l2 as energyCategoryL2, s.energy_category_l3 as energyCategoryL3, s.emission_subcategory as subcategory, u.subcategory_name as subcategoryName, coalesce(s.calculation_unit_code, u.calculation_unit) as unitCode, us.unit_name as unitName, s.subtotal_energy_value as energyValue, s.subtotal_carbon_emission as carbonValue from emission_calc_node_summary s inner join emission_calculation_node cn on cn.id = s.calculation_node_id inner join emission_calculation_template ct on ct.id = s.calculation_template_id left join emission_node_info ni on ni.node_id = cn.node_id left join emission_calc_unit_default u on u.subcategory_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = s.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci left join emission_unit_standard us on us.unit_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = coalesce(s.calculation_unit_code, u.calculation_unit) collate utf8mb4_general_ci where ct.status = 2 and ct.calculation_cycle_end_date >= #{rangeStart} and ct.calculation_cycle_start_date <= #{rangeEnd}

select ct.id as templateId, date_format(ct.calculation_cycle_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as cycleStart, date_format(ct.calculation_cycle_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as cycleEnd, date_format(ct.calculation_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as calculationEndTime, cn.id as calcNodeId, cn.node_id as sourceNodeId, cn.name as nodeName, coalesce(cn.node_category, ni.node_category) as nodeCategory, d.energy_category_l1 as energyCategoryL1, d.energy_category_l2 as energyCategoryL2, d.energy_category_l3 as energyCategoryL3, d.emission_subcategory as subcategory, coalesce(u.subcategory_name, di.item_value, d.emission_subcategory) as subcategoryName, coalesce(d.measurement_unit, u.calculation_unit) as unitCode, coalesce(us.unit_name, d.measurement_unit, u.calculation_unit) as unitName, coalesce(d.adjusted_energy_value, d.energy_measurement_value) as energyValue, coalesce(d.adjusted_carbon_emission, d.carbon_emission) as carbonValue from emission_collection_node_data d inner join emission_calculation_node cn on cn.id = d.calculation_node_id inner join emission_calculation_template ct on ct.id = cn.calculation_template_id left join emission_node_info ni on ni.node_id = cn.node_id left join emission_calc_unit_default u on u.subcategory_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = d.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci left join emission_data_dict_item di on di.item_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = d.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci and di.dict_id = (select id from emission_data_dict where dict_code = 'emission_subcategory' limit 1) left join emission_unit_standard us on us.unit_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = coalesce(d.measurement_unit, u.calculation_unit) collate utf8mb4_general_ci where ct.status = 2 and ct.calculation_cycle_end_date >= #{rangeStart} and ct.calculation_cycle_start_date <= #{rangeEnd}

select n.id as id, n.name as name, n.parent_id as parentId, i.node_category as nodeCategory from emission_node n inner join emission_node_info i on i.node_id = n.id where i.node_category in ('BRANCH', 'REGION', 'STATION') order by n.sort_order, n.name, n.id
select id, category_code as categoryCode, category_name as categoryName, parent_id as parentId, level from emission_energy_category where status = 1 order by level, sort_order, id

select code, max(name) as name, max(unitCode) as unitCode from ( select subcategory_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci as code, subcategory_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as name, calculation_unit collate utf8mb4_general_ci as unitCode from emission_calc_unit_default union all select d.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci, coalesce(di.item_value collate utf8mb4_general_ci, d.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci), d.measurement_unit collate utf8mb4_general_ci from emission_collection_node_data d left join emission_data_dict_item di on di.item_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = d.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci and di.dict_id = (select id from emission_data_dict where dict_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = 'emission_subcategory' limit 1) where d.emission_subcategory is not null and d.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci <> '' union all select s.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci, coalesce(u.subcategory_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci, s.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci), s.calculation_unit_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci from emission_calc_node_summary s left join emission_calc_unit_default u on u.subcategory_code collate utf8mb4_general_ci = s.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci where s.emission_subcategory is not null and s.emission_subcategory collate utf8mb4_general_ci <> '' ) names where code is not null and code collate utf8mb4_general_ci <> '' group by code order by code
